logo.title: Logo
logo.description: Shown instead of your brand’s name at the top of every page and, in large, at the foot of the Atelier template.
logo.hint: Upload an SVG file in one colour. Your site draws it in its own colours, dark on light pages and light on dark ones. Text in the file must be converted to outlines first.
logo.removeDescription: Your site will show “{brand}” in letters again. You can upload a logo again at any time.
logo.saved: Logo saved. It’s on your site now.
logo.none: No logo yet: your site shows its name in letters.

errors.tooBig: This file is too large. A logo’s SVG is usually well under 1 MB.
errors.notSvg: This isn’t an SVG file. Please export your logo as SVG (vector), not PNG or JPG.
errors.text: This logo has text in it. In your design app, convert the text to outlines (“Create outlines” / “Outline stroke”) and export it again.
errors.image: This SVG only wraps a picture (PNG or JPG). Please use a vector version of your logo.
errors.use: This SVG reuses shapes in a way the site can’t read. Export it again with shapes flattened (“Outline” / “Flatten”).
errors.stroke: Parts of this logo are drawn as lines. In your design app, choose “Outline stroke” and export it again.
errors.clip: This logo uses a clipping mask or a mask, which the site can’t apply. In your design app, release the clipping mask (or choose Expand / Flatten) and export it again.
errors.empty: There’s nothing to draw in this file.
errors.tooComplex: This logo has too many details for a website. Please simplify it or export it with fewer points.
errors.invalid: This SVG file couldn’t be read. Please export it again as a plain SVG.

theme.title: Site template
theme.description: How your website looks to visitors. The admin panel and the instructor panel always keep their own look.
theme.label: Template

descriptions.default: The site’s original look: light, simple and calm, with clay-coloured touches.
descriptions.atelier: Warm creams and browns, large photos and elegant headings, just like an art studio.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: The fonts of the {theme} template: for each language, one for headings and one for text. Each template keeps its own.
fonts.usingThemeFonts: These are the template’s own fonts.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: How headings and text will look on your site.
preview.unsaved: Showing changes you haven’t saved yet.

errors.font: Choose a font from the list.
errors.weight: This font doesn’t come in that weight. Please choose another.
